commitResults.messageBody: Introduce TaskList as the owner of the in-memory task collection, including task addition, retrieval, removal, counting, and a read-only view for persistence.\n\nUpdate Alice to delegate collection operations to TaskList while retaining command handling and preserving all existing console output. This creates a focused domain abstraction that will support later Parser and Ui extractions without changing user-visible behavior.

Introduce Ui to own Alice's standard-input reading and all console rendering, including task confirmations, errors, task lists, and date-query results.\n\nUpdate Alice to coordinate commands through Ui while preserving the existing command behaviour and exact user-visible output. This narrows Alice's responsibility and prepares the remaining command interpretation logic for a later Parser extraction.

Introduce Parser to identify command words, create todo, deadline, and event tasks, validate task numbers, and parse date-query arguments.\n\nSimplify Alice so it coordinates parsed commands with TaskList, Storage, and Ui instead of directly performing input validation and date-time conversion. Existing command behaviour and output are preserved.

Add TaskList date-query operations that determine whether deadlines and events occur on a requested date.\n\nUpdate Ui to render the returned matching tasks without inspecting task subtypes. This keeps date-matching domain rules with the collection that owns the tasks while preserving current output and task numbering.

Move Alice classes from the default package into alice, alice.ui, alice.parser, alice.storage, alice.task, and alice.exception packages.\n\nAdd the package declarations and cross-package imports required by the new structure while keeping src/main/java as the source root. This separates application coordination, user interaction, parsing, persistence, task-domain classes, and exception handling without changing runtime behaviour.
Record in Alice that Codex was used to support the OOP class design.
